items.topic: Salesforce external ID for CMS upserts
items.statement: Per Gemini notes, Marc proposed defining an external ID on the Salesforce side so the CMS can upsert by that ID, so that data can still be updated if the first call fails. Kobi said this needs more design and planning, and the architecture was still being finalized with other team members.
items.quote: To address potential issues with data synchronization or API calls, Marc Cabantog proposed defining an external ID on the Salesforce side. Kobi Kunasekaran noted that this requires further design and planning to ensure functionality. They are working with other team members to finalize this architecture.
